Explain how Chrome extensions handle service workers in Manifest V3.

Manifest V3 extensions use event-driven background service workers instead of persistent background pages.

This architectural design dramatically optimizes memory and CPU consumption across active tabs.

How does the Quote Reply extension speed up follow-up questions?

Quote Reply lets you highlight any specific passage from Gemini's response and directly quote it into your follow-up prompt with clean Markdown formatting.
